voxy.config.title: Voxy config
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of background threads Voxy uses for ingest, saving and mesh building. Higher values trade CPU for faster LoD updates.
voxy.config.general.bakeThreads.tooltip: Number of threads used to bake LoD block-model textures. Baking bursts on first connect and resource reloads, so more threads reach full LoD detail faster (at the cost of more CPU during those bursts). Default is half your cores (capped at 6). Applied when the renderer reloads — toggle Voxy rendering off/on or rejoin the world to apply.
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Allows Voxy to share Sodium's chunk builder threads for LoD mesh generation. Disable to keep Voxy strictly on its own dedicated threads.
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.multiplayerMode.tool:
How Voxy behaves on a multiplayer server.
AUTO: server-streaming if the server has Voxy, otherwise local ingest.
CLIENT_ONLY: always ingest locally even if the server has Voxy. Useful when the server streams too slowly or is overloaded.
SERVER_STREAM: require the server to have Voxy. If absent, Voxy disables itself.
A reconnect is needed for the change to fully apply.
voxy.config.general.rendering.tooltip: Toggles the LoD renderer. When off, Voxy keeps ingesting and saving but draws nothing.
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Screen-space size threshold (in pixels) below which a LoD section is downgraded to a coarser level. Lower = sharper LoDs but more geometry.
voxy.config.general.quality.tooltip: How far each LoD ring lasts before its downgraded to a lower detail level
voxy.config.general.geometryBuffer.toolt: How many quads the geometry buffer can hold
voxy.config.general.maxSections.tooltip: The max number of sections the renderer can contain
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: The render distance in chunks (set to -1 to disable chunk unloading)
voxy.config.general.vanilla_fog.tooltip: Apply Minecraft's vanilla fog to LoD chunks. Disable for a cleaner long-distance view.
voxy.config.general.high_res_model_textu: Bake LoD block textures at 16px per face instead of 8px, for sharper nearby LoDs. Farther LoDs stay 8px or lower automatically (atlas mipmaps), so only close-up detail improves. Costs more VRAM: the model atlas is a fixed ~512MB instead of ~128MB (independent of modpack size). Requires a game restart to apply.
voxy.config.general.render_statistics.to: Displays Voxy's render-side counters (sections drawn, geometry size, GPU memory) on the F3 debug overlay.
voxy.config.general.debug_dump_on_screen: When taking a screenshot (F2), also writes a sidecar .txt file next to the PNG containing player position, Voxy state, render stats, Iris/Sodium info, GL info and tail log. Useful when reporting visual bugs.
voxy.config.general.log_gap_diag.tooltip: Logs [GAP-DIAG] lines for every LOD-0/1 mesh build (null section, empty mesh, geometry size). Very chatty — only enable when investigating visible LOD holes/gaps.
voxy.config.general.diag_first_connect.t: Opens a 60s diagnostic window each time the client sends a LOD sync request. Emits [VoxyDiag] events (mapper/remapper timing, sync complete), a 1Hz snapshot of pending/received/applied sections and bake-pipeline state, and per-frame timing warnings for hot main-thread paths (>5ms). Use to investigate first-connect freezes.
voxy.config.general.nvmesh.tooltip: Use nvidia mesh shaders if possible to render LoDs
voxy.config.threads.ingest.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for ingesting new chunks
voxy.config.threads.saving.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for saving sections to the storage backend
voxy.config.threads.render.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for generating render data
